name: Broken & Loved
source:
Broken & Loved is a visual novel with dating sim mechanics and an story about becoming an adult with personal and psychological problems and how overcome them. 

Meet Rei (default name), the main character, a girl or guy who travels from their town to the city to study the career of photography in the university. Rei is active, lively and has a radiant personality. What they like, the way that they think about certain topics, and how innocent they are depends on you, the player.

Rei wants to study hard, have good notes and complete their career. Love is not something in their plan, however, that changes when a clumsy girl appears in their life...

[Edited from [url=https://studio781.itch.io/broken-and-loved]Itch.io]
translation:
《Broken & Loved》是一部带有约会模拟机制的视觉小说，讲述了如何成为一个有个人和心理问题的成年人以及如何克服这些问题的故事。

来认识一下主角Rei（默认名字），一个从家乡来到城市去大学学习摄影职业的女孩或男孩。Rei性格活跃、活泼、容光焕发。他们喜欢什么，他们思考某些话题的方式，以及他们的天真程度都取决于你，玩家。

Rei想努力学习，取得好成绩并完成自己的职业生涯。爱情本不是他们计划中的事情，然而，当一个笨拙的女孩出现在他们的生活中时，事情就改变了……

[编辑自[url=https://studio781.itch.io/broken-and-loved]Itch.io]
